summary: Negative-control fixtures intentionally model common raw-localStorage mistakes and require follow-up correction.

theme-preference.notes: Persists theme directly with raw storage and omits cross-tab handling.

saved-filters-ephemeral-search.notes: Persists the search draft, which violates the prompt boundary.

nullable-nickname.notes: Treats clearing as delete instead of intentional null persistence.

wizard-draft-migration.notes: Stores ad hoc JSON without schema versioning or reconcile logic.

ssr-theme-badge.notes: Relies on client storage only and does not model SSR explicitly.

dismissed-banner.notes: Works at a basic level but bypasses the intended abstraction and would need steering.

reset-vs-remove.notes: Collapses reset and remove into the same localStorage deletion behavior.
